title: Vayu-WARN — Real-Time Disaster Alert System
description: A real-time disaster alert web app with structured URL routing and live emergency data aggregation. Features role-based access controls, serverless data quality checks, and interactive Leaflet maps for geospatial content display.

title: Mockly AI — Voice-to-Voice AI Mock Interview Platform
description: An online mock interview platform with real-time voice-to-voice AI interaction. Implements content analysis and evaluation logic to process interview responses and deliver instant structured feedback.

title: CampusVault — Academic Resource Hub for GBPIET
description: A centralized academic resource hub built for GBPIET students — offering course materials, notes, previous year papers, and announcements in one organized platform with Firebase-powered backend.

title: GBPIETsync — Online Attendance Management System
description: This web app is designed to simplify and digitize the attendance process for faculty members. Teachers can easily create classes, mark attendance dynamically, analyze student records, and even generate attendance reports in PDF format.

title: Graphixa — Full-Stack Digital Products E-Commerce Store
description: A modern, production-ready full-stack web application for selling, managing, and securely delivering digital products. Includes a public storefront, secure admin dashboard, digital file delivery system, and cloud-based asset management.

title: Forecastly — Real-Time Weather Forecasting App
description: A responsive and user-friendly web app that provides real-time weather information for any location worldwide. Fetches live data from a trusted weather API and displays accurate weather conditions in an intuitive interface.

title: WordWise — API-Based Dictionary App
description: An API-based web application of a dictionary with real-time word definitions, phonetics, and usage examples powered by a public dictionary API.
